clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Dimensions for special shapes of clay brick used in building and other civil engineering construction. It does not lay down the specification of the special shapes for clay bricks and same shall conform to IS 1077:1991* and IS: 2180:1988†. Note  —For exact shape of clay bricks and detailed dimensions, refer to Fig. 1 to 7 of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 6165:1992 Specification  for  dimensions for special shapes of clay bricks (first revision) SUMMARY OF IS 6165 : 1992 DIMENSIONS FOR SPECIAL SHAPES OF CLAY BRICKS (First Revision) Shape Major  Overall Dimensions m m a)  Closers — i)     Snapheader closer 90 × 90 × 90 ii)    King closer 190 × 90 × 90 iii)   Queen closer 190 × 40 × 90 b)  Copings — i)     Half round coping 290 × 90 ii)    Saddle back coping 290 × 90 ×145 c) Bullnose Bricks — i)     Single bullnose or bullnose header ii)    Double bullnose iii)   Bullnose stretcher 190 × 90 × 90 iv)   Bullnose mitre v)    Bullnose double vi)   Bullnose on end d) Corner bricks — i)     Squint 300 ii)    Birdsmouth 300 iii)   Header splay 190 × 90 × 90 iv)   Single cant or plinth header v)    Double cant
